title: Create: Villager
description: a villager trading items from the create mod
body:
# Create:Villager
is a mod that adds a way of getting create materials through trading.

## reason for the mod
If you have ever played create before you probably got annoyed by having to craft multiple things just for one item, even a basic one (fan requires you to craft a casing and a propeller wich you also need an iron plate for).

## The Solution
Using a Villager with a **_dried kelp block_** as profession block this mod lets you trade tokens. 

![Trading tokens](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/505b7fff7e63e0de49672387a629685276232b4a_0.webp)

they are 'coupons' for different categories of create items and can be used in stonecutters ![Example1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab565bcd9cd3a5642f61d74c553fc713c7d411b5_0.webp)![Example2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/61ebfeb6685bac5683c2b0186ae7442873004aee_0.webp)

therefore you don't need too craft all the items the complicated way. 

It also helps to get started with create in less time
so you can focus more on building and designing machines and less on crafting fans & similar things.

## Suggestions 
1.if you want to add own.   recipes use KubeJS and if the item fits in no category use the 'A Token'.

2.the mod 'sophisticated backpacks' has a stonecutter upgrade for the backpack wich let's you use your tokens without having to place down a stonecutter every time.

These mods are great in general so I would recommend installing them even if you don't need these features.
